items.docs: The Grafana Get Home Dashboard API operation retrieves the dashboard that is configured as the home dashboard for the current user or organization. When a GET request is made to the /dashboards/home endpoint, it returns the dashboard data that should be displayed when a user first logs into Grafana or navigates to the home page.
